title: device transfers
description: What the run copied between host memory and device memory, counted where each copy is made. A copy inside the device, or inside the host, is not counted. On a multi-process run these are the totals of the process that wrote the results.

host_to_device_bytes.description: Bytes copied from host memory into device buffers.

device_to_host_bytes.description: Bytes copied from device buffers into host memory.

host_to_device_copies.description: The number of copies that host_to_device_bytes adds up: the same bytes in many small copies is a different finding from one bulk copy.

device_to_host_copies.description: The number of copies that device_to_host_bytes adds up.
